name: PickMe
description: Ride-hailing, food and delivery app operating across Sri Lanka.
proof_point: 165,000+ driver earners and about 1.9M monthly app users (Aug 2026); revenue Rs 6.2bn in the first nine months of FY25/26, up 50%.
status_note: Listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange Sep 2024 (PKME.N0000).
status_short: Listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange, 2024

name: Creately
description: Web-based visual workspace for diagrams, flowcharts, org charts and team planning.
proof_point: Diagramming and visual collaboration SaaS built since 2008 by Colombo-founded Cinergix, now headquartered in Melbourne.
status_note: Company HQ listed as Melbourne, Australia; Sri Lankan founder/CEO and Colombo engineering origin (Cinergix). Revenue is a third-party estimate.

name: PayHere
description: Online payment gateway letting Sri Lankan businesses accept cards and wallets.
proof_point: Company describes itself as Sri Lanka's No.1 online payment gateway with the largest customer base (company claim); Seylan Bank partnership mobilised 300+ merchants (2021).
status_note: Founding year approximate (announced as upcoming May 2016). Founder per readme.lk 2016.

name: Mintpay
description: Buy-now-pay-later app splitting purchases into interest-free instalments at partner stores.
proof_point: 3,000+ partner brands (company site); Rs 51.5m seed from Tenity, nVentures, Lankan Angel Network and Seylan Bank.

name: Koko
description: Buy-now-pay-later app: pay in three interest-free instalments online and in store.
proof_point: About 2M users and 6,500 merchants; Overall Gold at LankaPay Awards (Mar 2026).
status_note: Founders not verified; Michael Sathasivam is Regional CEO. Founding year from a third-party profile.

name: Helakuru (Bhasha)
description: Sinhala keyboard that grew into a super app with payments, news and ride-hailing.
proof_point: Used by 4.4M Sri Lankans daily (Jul 2025); HelaPay passed Rs 1bn in transactions within two years.
status_note: Operated by Bhasha Lanka (Pvt) Ltd.

name: oDoc
description: Video consultation app connecting patients with doctors, plus corporate health plans.
proof_point: US$1M pre-Series A led by Techstars with Hustle Fund and Unpopular Ventures; 1,000+ partner doctors, clients in 4 countries (2021).
status_note: Proof point is from 2021; site live in 2026 search index.

name: Logical
description: Desktop AI copilot that understands work context across apps and acts on it.
proof_point: Accepted into Y Combinator; raised over Rs 150m (~US$446k) seed; reported first all-Sri Lankan founding team in YC (Jul 2026).
status_note: Official website not verified (YC page fetch blocked). Founded year approximate.

name: Scouts
description: AI drone systems that patrol plantations, warehouses and solar farms and detect incidents.
proof_point: Closed an investment round at Rs 1.6bn (~US$5M) valuation, led by SITREK Security Solutions (Jul 2026).
status_note: Website from Seedtable profile. Other co-founders not named in sources.

name: WealthOS
description: Cloud platform banks and wealth firms use to run digital investment and pension products.
proof_point: Acquired by JPMorgan Chase (Jan 2026); earlier raised £4M from Barclays and Main Set.
status_note: EXIT: acquired by JPMorgan Chase, Jan 2026 (price undisclosed). UK-incorporated, 50+ staff in Sri Lanka.
status_short: Exit: acquired by J.P. Morgan in 2026

name: Ceylon Graphene Technologies
description: Produces graphene from Sri Lankan vein graphite for batteries, coatings and research.
proof_point: Graphene-enhanced lead-acid car battery cleared for export markets; first graphene company in Sri Lanka.
status_note: Joint venture of LOLC Group and SLINTEC; corporate-backed, not founder-led.

name: SenzMate
description: Jaffna-born AIoT platform (SenzMatica) for agriculture, insurance, medtech and industry.
proof_point: Operates in 15+ countries with 100+ staff; platform used in 50+ projects globally (2023, company data).
status_note: Work began 2013; incorporated 2015 via Yarl IT Hub. SenzAgro is its agri product.

name: Tracified
description: Blockchain traceability platform proving origin and handling of food and export goods.
proof_point: GIZ/EU-funded traceability for 10,000 Sri Lankan farmers; ADB project in Azerbaijan; equity from Tokyo VC 360ip.
status_note: Incubated by 99x (StartupX Foundry). Founding year approximate. Latest proof from 2021.

name: XpressJobs
description: Online job platform with CV-less applications and an AI WhatsApp recruiting assistant.
proof_point: Emerging Media invested Rs 100m for a 25% stake (2020, 3,600+ clients then); launched AI WhatsApp recruitment assistant with John Keells (Sep 2025).
status_note: Founders not verified (CEO Chathum Henegama, COO Dr Oshadie Korale). Acquired MyJobs.lk. Founding year approximate.

name: BoardPAC
description: Digital board-meeting platform with e-signatures and AI meeting minutes.
proof_point: 1,000+ enterprise customers and 50,000+ users in 40+ countries; clients include Vodacom, Deloitte, Petronas, OCBC.
status_note: Founded 2006 per e27 (pre-2008). Founders not verified.

name: Jendo Innovations
description: Non-invasive device and AI that screen for early cardiovascular disease in minutes.
proof_point: Closed new investment round led by US investors (Sep 2025); patents in Sri Lanka, Japan and US; FDA process underway.
status_note: Other named directors: Heminda Jayaweera, Vinod Samarawickrama. Lanka Ventures PLC also invested.

name: Magicbit
description: Learning boards and kits for coding, robotics, IoT and electronics.
proof_point: US$120k from Lankan Angel Network, Hyperion Ventures and Avarna; user community in 38 countries; SLASSCOM Startup of the Year 2022.
status_note: Names listed as core team on company site (University of Moratuwa engineers).

name: DirectPay
description: Payments app and merchant tools: QR, transfers, virtual POS and online checkout.
proof_point: Reported 1000x growth in 60 months (Oct 2024); 7,000+ merchants and US$7.5M valuation by 2021.
status_note: John Keells X investment. Shares founder with PayMedia.

name: PAYable
description: Mobile POS, card terminals and online gateway for small and medium merchants.
proof_point: Crossed Rs 100bn in processed volume (Aug 2025).
status_note: Founding year approximate ('over a decade ago').

name: WEBXPAY
description: Online payment aggregator and checkout for Sri Lankan SMEs.
proof_point: 2,000+ businesses on the platform; Visa partnership to digitise 10,000 SMBs (2022).
status_note: Proof point from 2022.

name: Onepay (Spemai)
description: Payment gateway and links for SMEs, with Shopify plug-in and unified checkout.
proof_point: First Sri Lankan payment gateway to be ISO-certified; Spemai backed by Japanese investment with a Japan branch.
status_note: Operated by Spemai Ltd; founding year not verified.

name: WSO2
description: Open-source API management, integration and identity software used by global enterprises.
proof_point: Acquired by EQT in 2024, reported at US$600M, Sri Lanka's largest tech exit; customers in 90+ countries.
status_note: EXIT: acquired by EQT (deal announced May 2024). Founded 2005, before the 2008 cutoff; include only as an exit highlight.

name: Cultive8 (formerly Agrithmics)
description: Digital procurement and payments linking farmers, tea factories and buyers.
proof_point: Hatch Fund Singapore invested ~US$650k (Jan 2026); earlier US$1.75M pre-Series A at US$8.25M valuation led by BRAC Osiris (2023).
status_note: Website NOT verified: cultive8.com is a parked for-sale domain; old domain agrithmics.lk. HQ moving to Singapore; Sri Lankan origin and operations.

name: Hyperglade
description: Blockchain platform channelling institutional capital into trade finance for underbanked borrowers.
proof_point: US$350k from Draper Associates.
status_note: Pivoted from NFT marketplace to trade-finance (Nov 2024 update). Website from e27 listing, not re-checked. Same lead co-founder as Scouts.

name: Curfox
description: AI delivery-management software for couriers and e-commerce, including return prediction.
proof_point: Gold at National ICT Awards 2024; company reports 10,000+ merchants and 10M+ orders.
status_note: Product of Parallax Technologies (est. 2014). Website not verified. Merchant/order figures from YourStory Apr 2025.

name: PayMedia
description: Digital onboarding, eKYC, wallets and remittance software for banks and financiers.
proof_point: Marked 12 years in June 2026; serves Sri Lankan banks and insurers, with operations in the Maldives and Nigeria.
status_note: Same founder as DirectPay; consider featuring one of the two.

name: findmyfare
description: Online flight, hotel and holiday booking with fare comparison.
proof_point: About US$2M investment from Ironwood Capital Partners (2018).
status_note: Proof point from 2018; site live with Sri Lanka, India and Singapore editions.

name: InsureMe
description: Online insurance marketplace and broker comparing motor, health and other policies.
proof_point: Listed on the CSE Empower Board on 1 Dec 2025, the first insurance intermediary to go public in Sri Lanka.
status_note: LISTED (CSE, Dec 2025). Website (likely insureme.lk) not verified. Other co-founders not named.

name: LankaPropertyWeb
description: Property listings portal with market data and an apartment finder.
proof_point: 16,000+ active property ads; acquired Lamudi.lk (2019).
status_note: Founded 2007 (just before cutoff). Founders not verified.

name: Takas.lk
description: Online electronics and lifestyle marketplace with islandwide delivery.
proof_point: Acquired by Ideal Group (Nalin Welgama).
status_note: EXIT: acquired by Ideal Group (Covid-era, exact date not stated). Website not re-checked; 2025-26 activity not verified.

name: OrangeHRM
description: Open-source and cloud HR management software for SMEs.
proof_point: 5M+ users worldwide (company press, 2024); Citra AI assistant launched Aug 2025.
status_note: FLAG: US-based company with Colombo R&D; first release 2006 (pre-2008). orangehrmlive.com confirmed live.

name: Kapruka
description: E-commerce and gifting platform delivering across Sri Lanka, including to overseas buyers.
proof_point: FY to Mar 2026 revenue Rs 1.92bn and returned to profit (PBT Rs 37.6m).
status_note: FLAG: founded 2002 (outside 2008 rule); listed on CSE since Jan 2022. Include only if you relax the age rule.

name: Vega Innovations
description: Designs electric vehicles, power electronics, battery packs and EV chargers in Sri Lanka.
proof_point: Built the Vega EVX, billed as South Asia's first electric supercar; partnered USAID Sri Lanka Energy Program (2022).
status_note: Started inside CodeGen International (group spin-off). Website and 2025-26 activity not verified.

name: ShoutOUT Labs
description: AI customer engagement and segmentation platform for brands.
proof_point: Clients in 10 countries including People's Bank, LOLC Cambodia, Dilmah and Sri Lanka Cricket.
status_note: Website not verified.

name: Electriquote
description: Generates electrical estimates and bills of quantities for construction projects.
proof_point: 50+ customers (Apr 2025).
status_note: Early stage; website and founding year not verified.

name: Spectrify AI
description: Computer vision and spectrometry for agricultural quality control.
proof_point: Named among 30 notable Sri Lankan startups (e27, 2024); cited in 2026 Sri Lankan AI ecosystem overview.
status_note: Thin evidence; founders and website not re-checked.

name: Worklenz
description: Cloud project management suite with task stages and productivity insights.
proof_point: Named among 30 notable Sri Lankan startups (e27, 2024).
status_note: Thin evidence; founders and website not re-checked.

name: simplebooks
description: Accounting, bookkeeping, payroll and company-setup services for small businesses.
proof_point: Backed by nVentures (e27, 2024).
status_note: Thin evidence; founders and website not re-checked.

name: ZigZag.lk
description: Online women's fashion retailer shipping across Sri Lanka, with physical flagship stores.
proof_point: Backed by BOV Capital and Hyperion Ventures (e27, 2024).
status_note: Founders per Venture Engine profile. 2025-26 activity not verified.

name: HaulMatic Technologies
description: Transport management platform for logistics operators.
proof_point: Launched its logistics platform at a national supply chain CEO forum (Oct 2023).
status_note: Weak proof; CEO Nipuna Jayathilake; founders, founding year and ownership not verified.

name: Kaiju Labs
description: Wallet-as-a-service and plug-in tools for apps and games.
proof_point: US$51k from Tenity (e27, 2024).
status_note: Thin evidence; drop first if short on space.
